rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from providers approved by APA, ASWB, CAMFT, CPA, NASP, NASW or NBCC; Board-recognized providers (AAMFT, AAMFT-CA, CALPCC, CAMFT, NASW-CA, CSCSW, CASP, CPA, CCA, ACA); qualifying postsecondary institutions (1 semester unit = 15 h, 1 quarter unit = 10 h); teaching for accepted providers (max 18 h per period)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 36 hours during the first renewal period plus a 7-hour HIV/AIDS course (and the one-time suicide and telehealth courses if not submitted with the licensure application).
rules.audit_note: Certify completion under penalty of perjury at renewal; do not submit certificates unless audited. Keep records at least 2 years from the renewal date.

topics.who: Licensees renewing or reactivating after Jan 1, 2021 (unless submitted with the licensure application)
Licensees renewing or reactivating after Jul 1, 2023 (must include telehealth law and ethics)
Supervisors of associates and MFT trainees (continuing professional development)

rules.notes: Renewal period runs from the day after issue/prior expiration to the license expiration date. One-time courses taken before the renewal period count for the one-time requirement but not toward the 36 hours. Associates: 3 hours California law and ethics per yearly renewal.
